project_name: NIFTY Options Dashboard — Kotak Neo Live Data Migration
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & INSTITUTIONAL TRADING DESK

design_philosophy.mood: Bloomberg / Order Flow Terminal precision meets modern Swiss neo-fintech
design_philosophy.tone: Mission-critical, crisp, low-latency, disciplined execution. Zero fluff.
design_philosophy.core_imperative: Absolute data integrity: Clear distinction between LIVE and DEMO mode with prominent status banner (LIVE, STALE, EXPIRED, MARKET CLOSED). No accidental executions or silent fallback to demo.

typography.font_family_heading: IBM Plex Sans, Outfit, Geist, -apple-system, sans-serif
typography.font_family_numbers_mono: IBM Plex Mono, Geist Mono, JetBrains Mono, monospace
rules: Never use Inter or generic sans for headers
Always use monospace tabular-nums for LTP, strike, OI, IV, Delta, PCR, and time ticks
Overline labels must be uppercase with tracking-[0.15em] or tracking-wider

LIVE.description: Kotak Neo SFeed connected (<5s tick heartbeat)

STALE.description: No market tick for >5 seconds during live hours

EXPIRED.description: Kotak Neo session token expired — one click re-login required

MARKET_CLOSED.description: NSE Market Closed (9:15 AM - 3:30 PM IST active window)

layout_and_grids.mode: MODE B: High Density Terminal Bento Grid

structure.top_bar: Sticky header with Brand logo, Index Selector (NIFTY / BANKNIFTY / FINNIFTY), Live Market Status Banner, Mode Pill (LIVE vs DEMO), and 'Connect Kotak Neo' CTA button
structure.market_summary_row: Dense grid of 4 metric cards: Spot Price & Day Range, PCR & Max Pain, Market Structure Bias (Bullish/Bearish/Neutral score), and Kotak SFeed Socket Health
structure.main_split: 2-column layout on desktop: Left/Center (7 cols) Option Chain & Greeks Ladder (OI, IV, Delta, LTP), Right (5 cols) Indicators & Signal Engine + Kotak Vault Connection Drawer

layout_and_grids.spacing: Dense financial layout (gap-3, p-3 to p-4) with clear 1px borders and nested rounded-lg cards to maximize screen real estate and data visibility without clutter

auth_endpoints.mpin_validate: POST /login/v6/totp/validate with MPIN (returns sid, token, baseUrl)
auth_endpoints.auth_status: GET /api/auth/status checking MongoDB vault and token TTL

normalization_schema.spot: { symbol: 'NIFTY' | 'BANKNIFTY' | 'FINNIFTY', ltp: number, change: number, pct_change: number, high: number, low: number, timestamp: string }
normalization_schema.option_chain: [{ strike: number, call: { ltp, change, oi, oi_change, iv, delta }, put: { ltp, change, oi, oi_change, iv, delta }, is_atm: boolean }]

image_urls.description: Stock market candlestick charts on deep dark monitor backdrop (subtle low-opacity texture in modal / header)
Financial analytics graphical interface reference for data density

accessibility_and_contrast.minimum_contrast_ratio: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large monospace numbers
accessibility_and_contrast.table_readability: Alternating subtle rows, green/red badges with dark background tints rather than pure text alone for colorblind accessibility
accessibility_and_contrast.tooltip_support: Explainers for Greeks (Delta, IV, PCR, Max Pain) on hover/focus

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.file_extension_rule: Use .js and .jsx files for new components if pure JS is preferred, or standard .tsx matching existing setup. Provide clear, runnable imports.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_rule: Every button, input, toggle, select option, banner, and key numeric display MUST have a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_upstox_references: Strictly scrub any legacy Upstox references from UI, tooltips, variable names, and documentation. All user-facing references must be Kotak Neo or generic NSE market data.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.demo_mode_clarity: DEMO mode must be distinctly colored and explicitly confirmed so traders know when data is simulated versus real live Kotak feed.
